如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    意识沉入系统之中，无言找到了自己想要的东西之后，才松了一口气，难怪任务奖励才各种点数各一千，这个任务原本就不是很难嘛…
无言笑了笑，对着桂雏菊说道：“嗯，我要入学，虽然白皇学院的入学考试很困难，但是我应该可以。”
桂雏菊皱了皱自己好看的眉头，对着无言严肃的说道：“你可不要小看白皇学院的入学考试，想要入学，必须考65分才算是及格，只有及格了才能进入白皇学院，这样你也决定要进入吗？”
“嗯，我确定！”何止是确定，是一定加肯定，要是靠自己的话，可能连10分都没有，但是还有系统啊…
看到无言好像毫不在意的样子，桂雏菊心中疑惑，难道这个男的真的有那么厉害？看起来不像一个知识分子啊，还带着剑，倒像是一个**份子。
“既然你已经决定了，那么我就带你去找老师，让他们帮你准备入学笔试吧。”虽然看起来好像很有威严的样子，但是会长大人其实还是一个心地善良的小女生嘛，对于刚见面的人，也不懈余力的去帮助…
“等等…”无言叫住桂雏菊。“我想，我应该得等一会，才能进行入学考试。”
“嗯？”桂雏菊纳闷的看着无言，既然有事，那么为什么不办完之后再来呢。
“没关系，如果有事情要忙的话，就先去忙吧，入学考试是什么时候都可以进行的，因为人本来就很少，甚至一整年都不见一个人来申请入学，所以你的时间很充分。”
“那个，不需要很久，大概一个小时左右就行了，不过有件事，倒是想要你帮帮忙。”无言摸了摸自己的鼻子，他已经能够想象，当自己提出自己的要求时，桂雏菊会是怎样怪异的眼神了。
桂雏菊呵呵一笑，对着无言说道：“有什么需要我帮忙的？不要客气，不管怎么说，我也是这个学院的学生会会长。”
是是是，知道你是会长大人了，而且在你‘出世’的时候就知道了，不用特意提醒…
心中吐槽着，无言尴尬的说道：“那个，能不能请你把书本借我一下…”
桂雏菊闻言不禁一愣，出乎意料的，她的脸上并没有什么意外，反而一脸笑容的看着无言，对着他说道：“其实，如果你没有信心的话，可以回家再复习几天，不用那么紧张的。”
好吧，原来会长大人是以为自己要临时抱佛脚…
“不用了，只要借我一个小时就足够了，再说了，就算回去，我也没有书本可以复习。”无奈之下无言只能解释道。
“没有书本！”桂雏菊惊讶的看着无言，好像看着一头史前巨兽一样，无言早就料到她肯定会是这样的表情，所以自动无视。
看到无言好像不是看玩笑的样子，桂雏菊当场就讶异了。
“你没有书本，也就是说你没有看过书咯？没有看过书，你怎么来考试啊！”
“嘛，因为各种各样的原因，所以…”

“你是在看不起白皇学院的入学考试吗？”这下子桂雏菊不满了，白皇学院可是出了名的贵族学院，入学的级别可是相当的高的，从那高达65分的门槛就可以看得出来了。
而现在，一个没有看过书的人，却是‘狂妄’的称只要一个小时的时间来看书，就能考过入学考试，这不是儿戏，就是在看不起白皇学院！
身为白皇学院的学生会会长，看到有人看不起白皇学院，只是稍微不满，已经算是很不错的了。
看到桂雏菊好像真的生气了的样子，无言心中有点发毛，生起气来的桂雏菊，可不是一般人能够抵御的了的，但是没有办法，不这样的话，自己根本就无从做起，入学更是想都别想了。
“额，你误会了，我没有看不起白皇学院的意思，要不然我也不会来入学了，我有足够的信心，所以才会那么说的。”无言只能这么解释了。
“充分的信心？也就是说，从来没有看过书的你，只需要看一个小时的书，就可以达到及格线吗？”桂雏菊很想笑，但是这样又有点不好，所以她撇了撇嘴，眯起双眼，看着无言。
是在鄙视吗？绝对是在鄙视吧！是的吧！
虽然无言很想这么吐槽，但是结果受伤的一定会是他，所以他只能无奈的点了点头。
“哼！”桂雏菊冷哼了一声，对着无言说道：“你是在开玩笑吗？”

After Wuyan found what he wanted, he breathed a sigh of relief. No wonder the task reward was only one thousand points each. This task was not difficult to begin with...
Wu Yan smiled and said to Gui Daiju: "Well, I want to enroll. Although the entrance exam of Baihuang Academy is very difficult, I should be able to do it."
Gui Daiju frowned her pretty brows and said seriously to Wu Yan: "Don't underestimate the entrance examination of White Emperor College. If you want to enter, you must pass the exam with a score of 65. Only if you pass can you enter White Emperor College. Do you decide to enter too?"
"Yes, I'm sure!" It's more than just confirmation, it's definitely affirmation. If you rely on yourself, you may not even get 10 points, but there is a system...
Seeing Wu Yan's seemingly unconcerned look, Gui Daiju wondered, could this man really be that powerful? He doesn't look like an intellectual, and he carries a sword, but he looks like a communist.
"Since you have decided, then I will take you to the teachers and let them help you prepare for the entrance written examination." Although he looks very majestic, the president is actually a kind-hearted little girl, and he will spare no effort to help people he has just met...
"Wait..." Wu Yan called Gui Daiju. "I guess I should have to wait a while before taking the entrance exam."
"Huh?" Gui Daiju looked at Wuyan in confusion. Since there was something to do, why not come back after finishing it.
"It doesn't matter. If you have something to be busy with, just go ahead and do it first. The entrance exam can be held at any time, because there are very few people, and you don't even see anyone applying for admission for a whole year, so you have plenty of time."
"Well, it won't take long, about an hour or so. But there is something I want your help with." Wu Yan touched his nose. He could already imagine the weird look in Gui Daiju's eyes when he made his request.
Gui Daiju smiled and said to Wu Yan: "How can I help you? You're welcome. Anyway, I am also the student union president of this college."
Yes, yes, I know you are the president, and I knew it when you were 'born', so there is no need to remind you...
He complained in his heart and said awkwardly, "Um, can you please lend me your book..."
Gui Daiju couldn't help being stunned when she heard this. Unexpectedly, there was no surprise on her face. Instead, she looked at Wu Yan with a smile on her face and said to him: "Actually, if you are not confident, you can go home and review for a few more days. You don't have to be so nervous."
Well, it turns out that the president thought he had to improvise...
"No, just lend me for an hour. Besides, even if I go back, I don't have any books to review." In desperation, Wu Yan could only explain.
"There is no book!" Gui Daiju looked at Wuyan in surprise, as if looking at a prehistoric beast. Wuyan had long expected that she would have such an expression, so he automatically ignored it.
Seeing that Wu Yan didn't seem to be joking, Gui Daiju was surprised on the spot.
"You don't have a book, which means you haven't read the book? How can you take the exam if you haven't read the book?"
"Well, for various reasons, so..."
"Are you looking down on the entrance examination of White Emperor Academy?" Gui Daiju was dissatisfied at this moment. White Emperor Academy is a well-known aristocratic academy, and the admission level is quite high, which can be seen from the high threshold of 65 points.
But now, a person who has never read a book is "arrogant" and claims that he can pass the entrance exam by just reading a book for an hour. This is not child's play;Look down on White Emperor Academy!
As the student council president of White Emperor Academy, it is quite good to see someone who looks down on White Emperor Academy and is only slightly dissatisfied.
Seeing Gui Daiju who seemed to be really angry, Wu Yan felt a little hairy in his heart. The angry Gui Daiju was not something ordinary people could resist, but there was no other way. Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to do anything, let alone enroll in school.
"Well, you misunderstood. I didn't mean to look down on White Emperor Academy. Otherwise, I wouldn't have come to enroll. I have enough confidence, so that's why I said that." Wu Yan could only explain it this way.
"Full confidence? In other words, you who have never read a book only need to read a book for an hour to reach the passing mark?" Gui Daiju wanted to laugh, but this was a bit bad, so she curled her lips, narrowed her eyes, and looked speechless.
Is it contempt? Definitely despising it! Yes!
Although Wu Yan wanted to complain like this, he would definitely be the one who got hurt in the end, so he could only nod helplessly.
"Hmph!" Gui Daiju snorted coldly and said to Wu Yan, "Are you kidding?"
